clips.title: The story
paras: On Fray Island, Klannoc Macleod puts warriors to the test. The human warrior welcomes fighters from both the Alliance and the Horde who seek mastery of combat stances. Those who earn his respect are sent inland to face greater trials of strength.

Klannoc Macleod puts seasoned fighters through their paces on Fray Island, off the Merchant Coast in the Barrens. Though human, he leaves Alliance and Horde quarrels aside. He judges each contender by grit, blade work, and resolve under fire.

Klannoc Macleod's trial on Fray Island is called the Affray. Contenders climb onto raised iron grating and face relentless waves of eager brawlers as he watches. Those who endure the onslaught and defeat his chosen champion earn his approval and prove they have the temperament for berserker training.
